documents_expected.why: apply page: eligibility, steps, deadlines, reporting
FAQ: match requirement, qualified donees, government teams
Stream 1 guide: criteria and eligible activities

eligibility.rule: A non-profit or community contribution company working on conservation or land and water use in BC
eligibility.quote: Grants are open to any non-profit organization or community contribution company (C3) working on conservation or land/water use issues in BC.
We will not accept applications from individuals or for-profit companies in this stream.

eligibility.rule: Non-Indigenous organisations show First Nation support
eligibility.quote: Non-Indigenous organizations can apply where First Nation support is demonstrated (i.e. through a letter or other form of support from the Nation).

eligibility.rule: Government teams may not apply directly
eligibility.quote: government teams may not directly apply for funding to support their initiatives or studies.

eligibility.rule: Area-based projects align with a government-to-government land use agreement
eligibility.quote: must align with a government-to-government agreement related to land use to guide the investment

documents.item: Letter of support from the First Nation (non-Indigenous applicants)
documents.quote: through a letter or other form of support from the Nation

effort.quote: New applicant First Nations or organizations can register their organizational and contact information through Fluxx
Before being invited to complete a full funding application for review, an expression of interest must be completed and reviewed by the BC Conservation Fund.
Approved EOI's are invited to submit a Full Proposal.

after_award.quote: Annual Reports: Once per year, these reports are focused breakdowns of the project over the past year.

notes: Quarterly check-ins are calls, not reports, so reports is yearly. First Nation applicants without a match may still apply. Provincial funds don't count as match. The next intake's deadlines are TBD; the current ones (EOI 12 Aug 2026, full 9 Oct 2026) have passed.
